outcome.technical: lastRun record in the shard. _evidence_io: RECORD_KEY, run_record (row -> record: runId, startedAt/durationMs/selectionMs, status/failed, verdictSource/reusedFrom, reuse key, gate digest, gateSource, leftToPhaseGate, banners, testedState {head, dirtyDigest, treeKey}, machine/attribution lines, launch; steps with name/exit/ran/outcome/failing cut at MAX_FAILING, durationMs only when measured here, reusedFrom on copied steps; a REUSED row copies its source's steps forward; MAX_STEPS with stepsDropped), pointer_from_record, record_stages, write_record (phase lock taken with a bounded wait RECORD_WAIT_SECONDS, the shard read UNDER the lock, lastRun + testEvidence + the task's timing stages in one save_plan_json, release only if taken, then the testEvidence journal row), subject_records, and reconcile now restores a pointer from the record when the ledger has no newer row. run-test-gate: --record builds the record (_run_record_of) and calls write_record; a record not written prints `record: NOT written - this run is only in <ledger path>` and is exit 3 on a green AND a red run (every exit site: verdict, all-left, empty gate, --json); new --launch TOKEN stored on the record. _task_timing: whole_ms, stamp_less, run_stages, append_run_stages (once per kind+runId). drive-phase: row_stages delegates to _task_timing.run_stages; queue_row queues only the wait stage for a gate run (the recorder appends gate+selection), keeps the repeat sentence off the built stages. audit-task group sign-off copies the carrier's lastRun (or one built from its row) to each member with gradedBy. Schema: $defs/lastRun, referenced from phase and task. Docs: COMPATIBILITY.md section 1 (additive; verdict source unchanged: a done task's commit trailers per section 3, else testEvidence; lastRun is the run the pointer names), CHANGELOG Unreleased Added+Changed, manifest-conventions.md, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (_task_timing, _evidence_io); module map regenerated with `python3 tools/lints/_deps.py --write-map` (g1 was red, _evidence_io now imports _task_timing). outcome.descriptive: A recorded gate run now leaves one lastRun record in its shard, with testEvidence derived from it and its timing stages written under the phase lock in the same write. A run whose record cannot be written exits 3.
